title: Jeruk Kedondong Pukul Dua
genre: Zapin Johor with gambus (acoustic gambus-and-marwas dance song)
subject: a husband in Muar sent out at 2 a.m. for jeruk kedondong for his craving wife, knocking on the pickle-lady's door and ending up helping her stir the jar
caption: Johor zapin dance song, traditional acoustic style. Gambus lute playing quick ornamented ostinato figures, accordion doubling the melody, a pair of marwas hand drums keeping the lively zapin rhythm, a rebana tambourine, light bass dumbak thumps. Dry acoustic room, live ensemble, drums forward in the mix. Male baritone lead, steady and cheerful, with a male group answering each chorus line. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 128 BPM, A minor. Playful, hurried, danceable mood. No synthesizers, no electronic beats, no autotune, no rap, no distorted guitar, no EDM drops.
lyrics:
[Intro - gambus ostinato, marwas drums]

[Verse 1]
Pukul dua pagi, isteri mengidam
Jeruk kedondong, kata dia, sekarang
Aku capai kunci, kedai semua tutup
Di Muar yang sunyi, aku mula berdoa

[Pre-Chorus]
Ketuk pintu rumah Mak Cik Siti
Dia bangun, dia tak marah pun

[Chorus]
Jeruk kedondong, masam manis garam
Mak Cik kacau balang, aku pegang lampu
Jeruk kedondong, belum masak lagi
Tunggulah dulu, Abang, duduk dulu

[Verse 2]
Mak Cik kata, jeruk perlu tiga hari
Aku kata, isteri aku tak sabar
Dia ketawa, dia hulur sebiji mentah
Gigit sikit, Abang, jangan menangis

[Pre-Chorus]
Mata aku kecil, muka aku kerut
Mak Cik tepuk bahu, bagus anak muda

[Chorus]
Jeruk kedondong, masam manis garam
Mak Cik kacau balang, aku pegang lampu
Jeruk kedondong, nanti Subuh siap
Pulanglah dulu, Abang, bawa sebalang

[Bridge - gambus and marwas only]
Pulang bawa balang, isteri dah tidur
Esok pagi dia nak nasi lemak pula

[Outro - gambus, accordion, marwas fade]
Jeruk kedondong, hei, jeruk kedondong
Pukul dua pagi, hei, tak tidur lagi
